title: Decorating bound methods in profiling utils breaks instance isolation
author: ViktoriiaRomanova

comments.author: sayakpaul
comments.body: Is this particular to LTX2 because it has two schedulers?

comments.author: ViktoriiaRomanova
comments.body:
Not specifically. The issue isn’t tied to LTX2 having two schedulers, but rather to the fact that the scheduler is deep-copied inside the `__call__ ` method.

Decorating a bound method freezes the `self` state at decoration time. In addition, without proper rebinding, the <class 'method'> is turned into a plain <class 'function'>, losing its descriptor behaviour. This can lead to a range of issues, especially when instances are copied.

LTX2 just makes the problem more visible, but the underlying issue is general and can occur in any pipeline.

comments.author: ViktoriiaRomanova
comments.body:
Under the same conditions (i.e., the scheduler is copied inside the pipeline’s `__call__`), I found the following pipelines that seem to follow this pattern:

* pipeline_ltx2_condition.py
* pipeline_ltx2_image2video.py
* pipeline_skyreels_v2_diffusion_forcing_i2v.py
* pipeline_skyreels_v2_diffusion_forcing_v2v.py
* pipeline_skyreels_v2_diffusion_forcing.py

> > Not specifically. The issue isn’t tied to LTX2 having two schedulers, but rather to the fact that the scheduler is deep-copied inside the **call**  method.

comments.author: Akash504-ai
comments.body: Fixes #13462. This updates the profiling utilities to decorate the underlying function instead of the bound method and rebinds it to the instance, preserving descriptor behavior and preventing shared state after deepcopy.
